item.description:
Clearer checks for translated search results

  • Complete Google Translate link targets now use the original publisher domain for local resemblance checks. Legitimate translated results no longer receive an impersonation warning solely because of Google's encoded address.
  • Suspicious publisher domains still receive the existing checks. Incomplete text and unsupported address formats keep conservative checks.

This app update preserves cloud-result handling, notification sensitivity and saved settings. A separate service update corrects the same translation-domain issue in cloud checks. Historical checks retain the findings recorded at the time.
